skills.name: edi-interface-review
skills.scope: All 28 pairs/56 directions, eleven contract facets, shared dependencies, feedback and authority

criteria.rationale: Twelve scoped requirements and eighteen unrun cases allocate existing IMP parents/F40-F43; source allocation only.
C0/C1/C3 subsets are concrete; native C6, model gateway and delta/refinement/actor/context contracts remain open.
One bounded controller/protocol/store reuses owner facades; no mandatory inference or agent framework.
Selected-cut citation guards, attributed candidate hypotheses, source/epoch binding and fallible critique are retained in source.
Finite local bounds and reservations exist in source; native tokenizer/provider complete-cost isolation and performance evidence remain open.
Journal/optimistic update and staged C3 retry are coded; crash/disk/quota/concurrency/restore cases remain unrun.
Existing saved protocol/growth/tools decisions reused; no new current-model/API or scientific-performance claim.
AST/import/parser/JSON/TOML/link checks and schema generation only. No product, model, runtime or qualification execution.

findings.detail: C1 occurrence/workspace/origin/source binding, selected ranges, whole-object digest and explicit critical-profile/unsupported limitations.
Exact world revision and dependency cut; no unselected or unpinned existing dependencies in candidate changes.
Unbound export jobs cannot masquerade as real model output; teacher is critique only against the same cut.
Durable unresolved-job reservation, conservative full token reservation and cancellation with unknown usage.
Immutable rival/test IDs and candidate-only C3 puts; attributed hypothesis/assumptions/evidence/rationale survive the bridge.
Denied/deferred frontier retained; unchanged proposals suppress duplicate outbox items; reopen requires material change.
Outbox artifact sequence and immutable episode reads prevent frontier updates from rewriting earlier proposals.
Exact staged C3 patch retained before submission; original request retry can repair a lost C4 receipt.

whole_system_review.indirect_paths: C0 mediates C2 derivation, C5 execution, C6 outcomes and C7 access; C4 never obtains cross-owner SQL or accepted-world write authority.
whole_system_review.feedback: Model consensus/teacher agreement is not external evidence. Original cuts/rivals persist; source origin classes survive. Scientific echo/selection safeguards need C6 qualification.
whole_system_review.shared_dependencies: C1 source store, C3 historical state, host clock/disk and future model gateway remain shared constraints. C1 intake does not initialize C4/C3.
whole_system_review.saturation: Finite queues/state and one unresolved job yield or reject; no circular waits on external tools. Fair scheduling, recovery availability and scale remain unverified.
whole_system_review.timing: Pinned historical cut is not current validity. No silent rebase, clock equivalence, source completeness or world causal identification is implied.
